description_en: Deletes a CIDR block from a transit router
description_zh: 删除转发路由器下CIDR地址段
kebab_example: aliyun cbn delete-transit-router-cidr --transit-router-id tr-p0w3x8c9em72a40nw0000 --transit-router-cidr-id cidr-0zv0q9crqpntzz0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteTransitRouterCidr

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may vary for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the transit router CIDR block.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462772.html operation to query the ID of a transit router CIDR block
parameters.help_zh:
转发路由器地址段ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462772.html接口查询转发路由器地址段ID
parameters.name: transit_router_cidr_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the transit router instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
转发路由器实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without deleting the transit router CIDR block. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and service limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and then deletes the transit router CIDR block after the request passes the check
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会删除转发路由器地址段。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接删除转发路由器地址段
parameters.name: dry_run
